changed.why: Five rulings, one per queue id. NEWCLASS-TF2-1: ratify rule A (the staged skeleton-tier word boundary) for unpointed runs; B and C rejected; P02-013's label ידעתם is a row defect (CWO-EZ-15, p02, one-word fix to וידעתם as its own refs entry already writes it); HARD known set enumerated (citation_sweep 10, normalizer 8 distinct) for the condition (c) re-run. FLAGS-TF2-1: ratify_with_changes - W1 adopted as proposed (all nine acceptances verified against pmarks; type test untouched; absence claims never inherit N-1); W2 adopted with the 'other' carve-out replaced by an exclusivity rule (scope = span kq keys not named anywhere in the row); W5 adopted in an implementable segment form; W6 added (letter-name absence form 'no pe or samekh'); P03-007 and P03-016 ruled true defects to FIXUP-1; P03-006 to S2 read-back; P11-012 wording order; four persisting false-positive classes recorded for T5 and Daniel, not ordered. REG-TF2-1: ratify_with_changes - four arms adopted with a 'rows of' lookahead and 'previously ... as' narrowing, five GREEN controls, coverage limit stated for CWO-EZ-14. SELFTEST-TF2-1: adopt. INSTALL-TF2-1: adopt - pre-authorized re-stage as toolfix2_batch3, condition (c) re-run as an equality test against the enumerated HARD set and the expected FLAGS deltas, install by digest, T5 launch; stop conditions named. Gate: toolfix2_may_install true, primaries_may_launch false, three conditions restated, rest 'as #e4'.
